name: degree_pos_of_root
statement: R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : IsRoot p a) : 0 < degree p

name: degree_sum_eq_of_disjoint
statement: S → R[X]) (s : Finset S) (h : Set.Pairwise { i | i ∈ s ∧ f i ≠ 0 } (Ne on degree ∘ f)) : degree (s.sum f) = s.sup fun i => degree (f i)

name: natDegree_sum_eq_of_disjoint
statement: S → R[X]) (s : Finset S) (h : Set.Pairwise { i | i ∈ s ∧ f i ≠ 0 } (Ne on natDegree ∘ f)) : natDegree (s.sum f) = s.sup fun i => natDegree (f i)

name: degree_map_eq_iff
statement: R →+* S} {p : Polynomial R} : degree (map f p) = degree p ↔ f (leadingCoeff p) ≠ 0 ∨ p = 0

name: degree_mul_leadingCoeff_inv
statement: K[X]) {q : K[X]} (h : q ≠ 0) : degree (p * C (leadingCoeff q)⁻¹) = degree p
